title: B1 Milestone 6: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Sexto Hito del Nivel B1. Tu manejo de condicionales pasados, vocabulario legal y gestión de proyectos es nivel ejecutivo.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 26 a 29 del nivel B1: 
- Third Conditional (If we had launched earlier, we would have won). 
- Contracts & Legal (Sign, breach, clause, binding).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 26 to 29 of the B1 level: The Third Conditional for past regrets, and Contracts and Legal vocabulary.

parts.visual:
- Phrasal Verbs (Set up, call off, figure out). 
- Project Management (Deadline, milestone, on track, behind schedule). 
¡Demuestra lo que sabes!
parts.audio: We will also review Business Phrasal Verbs, and vocabulary for Project Management. Show what you know!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 26-29).

questions.question: If we had signed the contract, we ____ the client. (Habríamos perdido).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia en el pasado = would have lost.

questions.question: I would have gone if you ____ me. (Hubieras invitado).
If they ____ research, it wouldn't have failed. (Hubieran hecho).
Please read the terms and ____ carefully. (Condiciones).
They broke the agreement. It's a ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
If you don't pay, we will ____ you. (Demandar).
Let's ____ up a meeting for next week. (Organizar).
The boss ____ off the project completely. (Canceló).
We need to ____ out a solution to this problem. (Descubrir / Resolver).
Friday is the ____ for this report. (Fecha límite).
We are two weeks behind ____. (Atrasados).
Reaching 10,000 users was a big ____ for us. (Hito / Etapa clave).
What ____ you have done? (Habrías).
This agreement is legally ____. (Vinculante).
They offered me the job, but I ____ it down. (Rechacé).
Good news! The project is on ____. (En camino / Según lo planeado).
We need to ____ more resources to the marketing team. (Asignar).
According to ____ 4, you must deliver by Friday. (Cláusula).
If I had known, I ____ have told you. (Habría).
Please ____ out this form. (Rellenar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

questions.question: If we ____ (had) more time, we would have finished. (Hubiéramos tenido)
We would ____ lost the client. (Habríamos)
A ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
We will ____ you. (Demandar con S)
Let's ____ up a meeting. (Organizar con S)
They ____ down our offer. (Rechazaron con T)
Friday is the ____. (Fecha límite con D)
An important ____. (Hito con M)
We are behind ____. (Atrasados con S)
To ____ resources. (Asignar con A)
